input_contract: Three positional arguments: plain integer node_count in 1..128; a plain list of 0..16384 edges, each a two-element plain list of integer vertices in 0..node_count-1; plain integer start in the same vertex range. No bools. Edges are directed, all have unit cost; loops and duplicate pairs are allowed.
output_contract: A new plain list of length node_count, with plain nonnegative integer minimum hop distances from start and None for unreachable vertices. Distance to start is zero. Leave the supplied edge list and its pairs unchanged.
allowed_operations: Self-contained Python loops, recursion, comparisons, plain arithmetic, local containers and ordinary builtins under the declared plain-input domain.
prohibited_operations: Imports, external graph solvers, reflection, dynamic execution, randomness, filesystem/network/process operations and persistent state.
consequence_horizon: One complete invocation across the declared directed unit-edge domain, including cycles, disconnected vertices, loops and duplicate edges.
consequence_signature: How distance information is discovered or improved, how the next propagation work is selected, and whether a vertex is finalized once or edges are repeatedly relaxed.
ignored_variation: equivalent FIFO queue or explicit layer containers
hybrid_policy: Keep reachable alternate general solvers from different families unresolved with reason hybrid. A helper performing one relaxation or selecting one frontier item is a component, not another observation. No fractional allocation.
novelty_policy: Keep unsupported mechanisms as schema_gap with original evidence. Changing class boundaries requires a new pack version and explicit reassessment.

classes.mechanism: First discovery propagates distances in FIFO arrival or explicit nondecreasing breadth layers; each discovered vertex enters the propagation frontier once.
classes.boundary: Selecting a globally minimum tentative label by an ordering operation is DIST-SETTLE. Re-enqueueing vertices after improved labels, such as general queue-based label correction, is outside this descriptor.

classes.mechanism: Choose a globally minimum finite tentative label among unsettled vertices, finalize that vertex once, and update labels through its outgoing edges.
classes.boundary: A FIFO first-discovery schedule does not qualify merely because its resulting distances happen to be nondecreasing on unit edges. A heap or full scan can implement the minimum selection.

classes.mechanism: Repeated passes over the complete edge relation improve distance labels, with bounded path-length rounds or a fixed-point stopping condition; no per-vertex minimum-label settlement is used.
classes.boundary: A single edge-relaxation component within FIFO or minimum-label settlement is not a separate mechanism. DAG-only topological propagation or queue-based repeated correction requires another descriptor.

validity_scope: Finite suite observations and supplied conformance remain separate from mechanism assignment. An incorrect implementation can retain its mechanism label while failing finite validity; passing a finite suite does not establish correctness over the entire domain.
reference: Project-defined mechanism resolution. Algorithm background: Sedgewick and Wayne, Algorithms, directed graph breadth-first paths and shortest paths, https://algs4.cs.princeton.edu/42digraph/ and https://algs4.cs.princeton.edu/44sp/. Descriptor prose and Python references are independently written.
